text: No pain today but my fingers were very stiff in the morning.
Sharp pain when I tried to close my fist, could not hold a cup.
Felt much better, did all my exercises and gripped a bottle easily.
Mild ache after typing, wrist is a bit tight but moving fine.
Pain is back and worse than last week, thumb barely moves.
Not as stiff as yesterday, but still cannot pick up small coins.
Moderate soreness in the evening, grip is weak when opening jars.
No pain, no stiffness. Full finger movement for the first time since surgery.
